evals.prompt: Which files triggered a review for @elastic/developer-docs? Use the offline fixture at skills/review/docs-codeowners/evals/fixtures/pr-8516 (CODEOWNERS and files.json). evals.expected_output: Runs the matcher on the fixture. Reports the two developer-docs files as the trigger, the observability near miss, and docset.yml under @elastic/docs. expectations: Runs scripts/match_codeowners.py on the pr-8516 fixture and does not call gh

Names the pull request comprehensive because of the added alerting page

Reserves the full review checklist for someone signing off on the whole pull request
Does not tell developer-docs to run the full checklist just because the pull request is comprehensive
